共同操作

A1

步骤 1：stir under the tabulated conditions

A2

步骤 1：reaction under Table 2 conditions

A3

加料顺序：substrate solution；Rh2(OAc)4 solution；通法出处：Section 4.4；操作记录：Detailed section 4.4 general procedure；步骤 1：prepare diazo-furan solution in DCM；步骤 2：syringe substrate solution dropwise into vigorously stirred Rh2(OAc)4 solution in a water bath；步骤 3：concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 4：purify crude product by silica-gel column chromatography with a suitable PE/EA mixture

A4

加料顺序：compound 3 solution；BF3.OEt2；通法出处：Section 4.5；操作记录：Detailed section 4.5 general procedure；步骤 1：stir under Scheme 2 conditions；步骤 2：quench with saturated aqueous NaHCO3；步骤 3：extract the water layer with DCM and combine organic layers；步骤 4：dry combined organic layers over Na2SO4 and concentrate in vacuum；步骤 5：purify residue by silica-gel column chromatography with a suitable PE/EA mixture

A5

加料顺序：TiCl4 and Et3N；Lewis acid and enone；quench；通法出处：Section 4.2；步骤 1：add TiCl4 and Et3N dropwise by syringe to vigorously stirred diazo-carbonyl solution；步骤 2：stir dark-red mixture；步骤 3：syringe Lewis acid and alpha-alkynyl enone solution; stir；步骤 4：quench with saturated aqueous NH4Cl；步骤 5：separate organic layer; wash with saturated aqueous NaHCO3 then NaCl; dry over anhydrous MgSO4; concentrate in vacuum；步骤 6：silica-gel column chromatography, EA/PE 1:20
